details:
Q1. Which part of this repository should be improved? Please include the exact workflow, file, or behavior inside the area you choose.
Choices:
A. Clarify / clarify-respond workflow
B. Plan / implement / review-autofix workflow
C. Orchestrate / judge / validate workflow
D. Docs / templates / repo setup
E. Other — specify the exact area (RECOMMENDED)
Q2. What kind of improvement do you want for that target area?
Choices:
A. Fix a broken behavior or regression — include current vs expected behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Add or change automation behavior
C. Improve safety / guardrails / correctness
D. Reduce runtime / noise / cost
E. Improve documentation / operator experience
Q3. What should count as “done” for this issue? Please include a brief concrete example or acceptance criteria.
Choices:
A. A specific failing workflow run / PR / issue should be fixed
B. A specific file, workflow output, comment, label, or prompt should change in a defined way
C. A short before/after acceptance-criteria list (RECOMMENDED)
D. Other measurable completion signal — describe
